## SAMOA — profile (page 209)

- **Header facts:** Region: East Asia & Pacific; income group: Upper-middle-income; lending category: IDA; data status: Data as reported (A); population: 219 thousand; GNI: 1,285.9; unit line: US$ million, unless otherwise indicated.
- **Total external debt stock, 2025:** 397.8, **+0.5% from 2024**.

- **Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25:** 2015 = **466.3**; 2025 = **397.8**. The line declines from 2015 to ≈2016, rises to ≈2017, then falls through ≈2019, rises again through ≈2021 where it appears to **peak**, and then declines sharply through ≈2024 before edging up slightly in 2025.

- **Figure 2. External debt by creditor and creditor type in 2025, including IMF credit and SDR allocations:**
  - **Total external debt:** 397.8
    - **Public & publicly guaranteed (PPG):** 298.2
    - **Private nonguaranteed (PNG):** 16.7
    - **Short-term:** 82.8
  - **PPG by creditor type:** 298.2
    - **Multilateral:** 203.1
    - **Bilateral:** 95.2
  - **Multilateral creditors:** 203.1
    - World Bank-IDA: 90.4
    - Asian Dev. Bank: 50.7
    - Other multilateral: 61.9
  - **Bilateral creditors:** 95.2
    - China: 79.4
    - Japan: 15.8

- **Figure 3. Debt ratios, 2015–25:**
  - **External debt / exports:** 101%, **+3.7%**. Trend: falls in the early years, spikes around the middle of the period, then declines and ends with a slight uptick by 2025.
  - **External debt / GNI:** 31%, **-9.3%**. Trend: broadly stable to slightly rising in the first half, then declines noticeably toward 2025.
  - **Debt service / exports:** 9%, **-1.4%**. Trend: modest early rise, sharp mid-period swings, then declines and flattens by 2025.
  - **Debt service / GNI:** 3%, **-13.8%**. Trend: rises gradually early on, dips, rebounds around the later middle years, then trends down to 2025.

- **Figure 4. Average terms on new commitments from official and private creditors, 2025:**
  - **Official creditors:** Maturity **..**; Grace period **..**; Interest rate **..**
  - **Private creditors:** Maturity **..**; Grace period **..**; Interest rate **..**

- **Note:** Figure 4 shows no data values for official or private creditors because the country did not have new commitments in 2025.
- **Source:** World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
